Line 17 standard deduction (person 0 born 1980-03-15 is 45 at December 31, 2025; 0 box(es) on lines 12a-12d): chart (PDF p.5) 15,000.00 = base 15,000.00 + 0 x 2,000.00; Maine AGI not over 100,000.00, so no worksheet; line 17 = 15,000.00. Line 13 = 1; line 18 exemption = 1 x 5,150.00 = 5,150.00 (Maine AGI not over 333,450.00). Line 19 taxable income = 60,150.00 - 15,000.00 - 5,150.00 = 40,000.00. Line 20 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.13): 5.8% x (26,800.00 - 0.00) = 1,554.40 + 6.75% x (40,000.00 - 26,800.00) = 891.00 = 2,445.40. The booklet's tax table (PDF pp.12-13) row 40,000.00 to 40,100.00 gives 2,448; expected keeps the schedule formula. Line 23 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 24 Maine income tax 2,445.40.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rate schedules as numbers. The booklet's table taxes 100-dollar rows and the printed schedule constants are rounded to dollars.
